name: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness Quotes

quotes.quote:
Don’t take yourself so seriously. You’re just a monkey with a plan.
别太把自己当回事。你只是一只会做计划的猴子。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: LEARNING HAPPINESS

quotes.quote:
Maybe happiness is not something you inherit or even choose, but a highly personal skill that can be learned, like fitness or nutrition.
可以说，幸福与基因无关，甚至与选择无关，它是一种与个体密切相关、可以后天习得的技能，就像通过锻炼强健体魄、通过吃饭摄取营养一样。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
Today, I believe happiness is really a default state. Happiness is there when you remove the sense of something missing in your life.
现在，我认为幸福就是一种不需要主动作为的状态。当把“缺憾感”从生活中剔除时，幸福感就会油然而生。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
Happiness is what’s there when you remove the sense that something is missing in your life.
幸福就是消除缺憾感之后的感受。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
To me, happiness is not about positive thoughts. It’s not about negative thoughts. It’s about the absence of desire, especially the absence of desire for external things.
对我来说，幸福不等同于积极的心态，也不等同于没有消极的想法。幸福是一种无欲无求的状态，特别是对外界事物的欲望。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
If you ever want to have peace in your life, you have to move beyond good and evil.
如果想获得内心的平和，你就必须超越对万事万物的善恶评判。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
The world just reflects your own feelings back at you. Reality is neutral. Reality has no judgments.
世界只是折射个人感受的一面镜子。现实是中性的，现实不做评判。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
There are no external forces affecting your emotions—as much as it may feel that way.
情绪看似是外力作用的结果，但其实并非如此。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
We think of ourselves as fixed and the world as malleable, but it’s really we who are malleable and the world is largely fixed.
我们都认为江山易改，本性难移，但事实是，我们是可塑的，而世界基本上是固定不变的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
A rational person can find peace by cultivating indifference to things outside of their control.
理性很强的人可以通过训练自己的无感反应获得平和，即学会漠视自己无法控制的事物。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
Real happiness only comes as a side-effect of peace. Most of it is going to come from acceptance, not from changing your external environment.
所以，真正的幸福只是内心平和的副产品，主要还是源于接受现实，而不是改变外部环境。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Learned

quotes.quote:
Happiness, love, and passion…aren’t things you find—they’re choices you make.
幸福，爱，激情……这些都不是我们追寻的事物，而是我们做出的选择。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is a Choice

quotes.quote:
Happiness is a choice you make and a skill you develop.
幸福是一种选择，是一种可以培养的技能。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is a Choice

quotes.quote:
Memory and identity are burdens from the past preventing us from living freely in the present.
记忆和身份只是来自过去的负担，让我们无法自由自在、心无旁骛地活在当下。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is a Choice

quotes.quote:
You can literally destroy your happiness if you spend all of your time living in delusions of the future.
如果每天都沉浸在对未来的规划和幻想中，那就是在亲手扼杀自己的幸福。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Presence

quotes.quote:
We crave experiences that will make us be present, but the cravings themselves take us from the present moment.
我们渴望那些让我们能感知当下的体验，殊不知，这样的渴望却让我们脱离了当下。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Presence

quotes.quote:
What if this life is the paradise we were promised, and we’re just squandering it?
你有没有想过，现在的生活可能就是上帝承诺给你的天堂，而你却毫不珍惜，肆意挥霍？
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Presence

quotes.quote:
A happy person isn’t someone who’s happy all the time. It’s someone who effortlessly interprets events in such a way that they don’t lose their innate peace.
幸福的人并不是时时刻刻都快乐的人。
幸福的人是可以轻松地以特定的方式诠释事件、保持内心平和的人。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Peace

quotes.quote:
Peace is happiness at rest, and happiness is peace in motion.
平和是静态的幸福，幸福是动态的平和。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Peace

quotes.quote:
The only way to actually get peace on the inside is by giving up this idea of problems.
因此，获得内心平静的唯一方法是摒弃“问题”这个概念。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Requires Peace

quotes.quote:
EVERY DESIRE IS A CHOSEN UNHAPPINESS
欲望是主动选择的不开心
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Every Desire Is a Chosen Unhappiness

quotes.quote:
The fundamental delusion: There is something out there that will make me happy and fulfilled forever.
我们的根本错觉是：总有一样东西会让我一直满足、永远快乐。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Every Desire Is a Chosen Unhappiness

quotes.quote:
Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
欲望就是你跟自己的约定，约定的内容是：不得到我想要的东西，我是不会快乐的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Every Desire Is a Chosen Unhappiness

quotes.quote:
Happiness is being satisfied with what you have.
Success comes from dissatisfaction. Choose.
幸福就是满足现状。
而成功源于对现状的不满，是对现状的改造。
两者只能选一个。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Success Does Not Earn Happiness

quotes.quote:
The problem with getting good at a game, especially one with big rewards, is you continue playing it long after you should have outgrown it.
当我们对一个游戏尤其是回报很大的游戏逐渐上手时，一个问题就会出现——你会沉迷其中，无法停止，即使这个游戏对你来说早已过于简单。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Success Does Not Earn Happiness

quotes.quote:
Survival and replication drive put us on the work treadmill. Hedonic adaptation keeps us there. The trick is knowing when to jump off and play instead.
生存和繁衍的本能驱使人们劳作，而享乐适应让我们步履不停。
幸福的秘诀在于，知道何时停下劳作的脚步，开始随心去玩耍。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Success Does Not Earn Happiness

quotes.quote:
The enemy of peace of mind is expectations drilled into you by society and other people.
内心平和的敌人是社会和其他人灌注给你的期望。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Envy Is the Enemy of Happiness

quotes.quote:
The reality is life is a single-player game. You’re born alone. You’re going to die alone. All of your interpretations are alone.
而现实是，生活就是一场单人游戏。人独自出生，独自死亡，独自解读人世间的一切。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Envy Is the Enemy of Happiness

quotes.quote:
Perhaps one reason why yoga and meditation are hard to sustain is they have no extrinsic value. Purely single-player games.
瑜伽和冥想很难坚持的一个重要原因也许就是，它们只关乎内心，没有外在价值，属于纯粹的单人游戏。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Envy Is the Enemy of Happiness

quotes.quote:
All the real scorecards are internal.
所有真正的评价标准都是内在的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Envy Is the Enemy of Happiness

quotes.quote:
When working, surround yourself with people more successful than you.
工作时，和比自己更成功的人在一起。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
When playing, surround yourself with people happier than you.
玩耍时，和比自己更快乐的人在一起。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
The first rule of handling conflict is: Don’t hang around people who constantly engage in conflict.
处理冲突的首要原则是，不要和经常参与冲突的人在一起。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
If you can’t see yourself working with someone for life, don’t work with them for a day.
如果不想跟一个人共事一生，那就一天都不要和他共事。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
The most important trick to being happy is to realize happiness is a skill you develop and a choice you make. You choose to be happy, and then you work at it.
获得幸福 重要的诀窍之一就是，认识到这是一种你可以锻炼的技能，是一个你可以做出的选择。也就是说，一个人可以选择幸福，并为之奋斗。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
The more you judge, the more you separate yourself. You’ll feel good for an instant, because you feel good about yourself, thinking you’re better than someone. Later, you’re going to feel lonely. Then, you see negativity everywhere.
对周遭评判得越多，自我就越膨胀。在某个瞬间，你状态极佳，因为此时你自我感觉良好，觉得自己比别人强。过了一会儿，你就会被孤独感吞噬，目之所及都是烦恼。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
The more secrets you have, the less happy you’re going to be.
你的秘密越多，幸福感就越低。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
A personal metric: how much of the day is spent doing things out of obligation rather than out of interest?
幸福指数的个人衡量标准是，一天中你有多少时间用于履行职责，而不是追随兴趣。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
Politics, academia, and social status are all zero-sum games. Positive-sum games create positive people.
政治、学术和社会地位都是零和游戏。正和游戏才能造就积极向上的人。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Happiness Is Built by Habits

quotes.quote:
In any situation in life, you always have three choices: you can change it, you can accept it, or you can leave it.
在生活中，无论面对何种状况，你都有三种选择：改变现状，接受现状，逃避现状。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
What is not a good option is to sit around wishing you would change it but not changing it, wishing you could leave it but not leaving it and not accepting it. That struggle or aversion is responsible for most of our misery.
很多人在遇到问题时会踟蹰不前，陷入空想：希望改变现状却没有横下一条心去改变，希望转身离开却没有毅然决然地离去，同时又不能心平气和地接受现状。这种纠结和回避的态度正是人生中大部分痛苦的来源。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
The phrase I probably use the most to myself in my head is just one word: “accept.”
我在脑海里对自己说得最多的就是两个字：接受。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
Fundamentally, it boils down to one big hack: embracing death.
从根本上说，就是学会坦然面对死亡。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
Your life is a firefly blink in a night. You’re here for such a brief period of time.
相对于宇宙，你就像一只在夜空中闪烁的萤火虫，你的生命转瞬即逝。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
EASY CHOICES, HARD LIFE.
HARD CHOICES, EASY LIFE.
选择简单模式，人生会越来越困难。
选择困难模式，人生会越来越简单。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Learning Happiness, Section: Find Happiness in Acceptance

quotes.quote:
Doctors won’t make you healthy.
Nutritionists won’t make you slim.
Teachers won’t make you smart.
Gurus won’t make you calm.
Mentors won’t make you rich.
Trainers won’t make you fit.
Ultimately, you have to take responsibility.
Save yourself.
医生不能让你健康。
营养学家不能让你苗条。
老师不能让你变聪明。
禅师不能让你冷静。
智者不能让你富有。
教练不能让你健壮。
最终，你必须自己负起责任。
救赎靠自己。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: SAVING YOURSELF

quotes.quote:
I never met my greatest mentor. I wanted so much to be like him. But his message was the opposite: Be yourself, with passionate intensity.
我从未亲眼见过那位伟大的导师。我一度极其渴望成为他那样的人。但是，他传达给我的信息恰恰相反：做自己，全情投入、义无反顾地做自己。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Be Yourself

quotes.quote:
No one in the world is going to beat you at being you. You’re never going to be as good at being me as I am. I’m never going to be as good at being you as you are.
在“做自己”这件事情上，没有人能与你竞争。你永远不会像我一样擅长做我自己，我也永远不会像你一样擅长做你自己。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Be Yourself

quotes.quote:
The combinatorics of human DNA and experience are staggering. You will never meet any two humans who are substitutable for each other.
先天基因和后天经验的组合会造就个体惊人的独特性。没有任何两个个体可以互相替代。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Be Yourself

quotes.quote:
Your goal in life is to find the people, business, project, or art that needs you the most. There is something out there just for you.
你的人生目标是找到最需要你的人、事业、项目或艺术。大千世界，芸芸众生，总有一些人和事会与你完美契合。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Be Yourself

quotes.quote:
To make an original contribution, you have to be irrationally obsessed with something.
要做出原创性贡献，必须非理性地痴迷。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Be Yourself

quotes.quote:
My number one priority in life, above my happiness, above my family, above my work, is my own health. It starts with my physical health. Second, it’s my mental health. Third, it’s my spiritual health.
我生活中的第一要务是我的身体健康。对我来说，健康的重要性高于幸福，高于家庭，高于工作。我的身体健康是一切的起点，排在第一位，紧随其后的是我的心理健康和精神健康。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
When everyone is sick, we no longer consider it a disease.
当所有人都生病时，我们就不会认为它是一种疾病了。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
The more processed the food, the less one should consume.
世界上最简单的饮食原则：食物加工程度越深，就应该越少摄入。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
The harder the workout, the easier the day.
锻炼越卖力，一天越轻松。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
One month of consistent yoga and I feel 10 years younger. To stay flexible is to stay young.
一个月的瑜伽练习让我感觉年轻了10岁，保持身体的柔韧性就是保持年轻的状态。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
The best workout for you is one you’re excited enough to do every day.
对个人而言，最好的锻炼就是每天都能坚持去做的那种锻炼。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Care for Yourself

quotes.quote:
Most of our suffering comes from avoidance.
我们大部分的痛苦都来自逃避。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Meditation + Mental Strength

quotes.quote:
Meditation is intermittent fasting for the mind.
冥想是思想意识的间歇性禁食。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Meditation + Mental Strength

quotes.quote:
Life-hack: When in bed, meditate. Either you will have a deep meditation or fall asleep. Victory either way.
生活技巧：躺在床上的时候，可以尝试冥想。这样，你要么进入深度冥想，要么会入睡。不管结果是哪种都很好。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Meditation + Mental Strength

quotes.quote:
Meditation is turning off society and listening to yourself.
冥想是屏蔽社会的噪声，倾听自己的声音。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Meditation + Mental Strength

quotes.quote:
Hiking is walking meditation.
Journaling is writing meditation.
Praying is gratitude meditation.
Showering is accidental meditation.
Sitting quietly is direct meditation.
徒步旅行是行走冥想。
写日记是书写冥想。
祷告是感恩冥想。
冲澡是意外冥想。
静坐是直接冥想。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Meditation + Mental Strength

quotes.quote:
The greatest superpower is the ability to change yourself.
最了不起的超能力就是改变自我的能力。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Build Yourself

quotes.quote:
You become your habits.
我们终究会成为自己的习惯。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Build Yourself

quotes.quote:
Impatience with actions, patience with results.
迅速采取行动，并对结果保持耐心。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Build Yourself

quotes.quote:
Inspiration is perishable—act on it immediately.
灵感本易逝，行动应当时。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Build Yourself

quotes.quote:
The current environment programs the brain, but the clever brain can choose its upcoming environment.
当前的环境会塑造大脑，但是聪明的大脑也可以选择和塑造未来的环境。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Grow Yourself

quotes.quote:
If there’s something you want to do later, do it now. There is no “later.”
如果有什么事情是你以后想做的，现在就去做，人生没有“以后”。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Grow Yourself

quotes.quote:
For self-improvement without self-discipline, update your self-image.
要想不借助自律而实现自我提升，你需要更新自我形象。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Grow Yourself

quotes.quote:
Grind and sweat, toil and bleed, face the abyss. It’s all part of becoming an overnight success.
流血流汗，埋头苦干，直面困难，这些都是一夜成名的必经之路。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Grow Yourself

quotes.quote:
The hardest thing is not doing what you want—it’s knowing what you want.
最难的不是做自己想做的事，而是知道自己想要什么。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
Be aware there are no “adults.” Everyone makes it up as they go along. You have to find your own path, picking, choosing, and discarding as you see fit. Figure it out yourself, and do it.
要注意，这个世界上根本没有什么“成年人”，假装成熟的人多了，也就有了成年人。你必须找到属于自己的路，按照自己的方式去挑选、抉择、取舍。先想清楚自己想要的是什么，然后付诸行动。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
Holding back means staying in bad relationships and bad jobs for years instead of minutes.
伪装意味着要年复一年地（而不是几分钟）让自己身处烦心伤脑的关系和工作中。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
Courage isn’t charging into a machine gun nest. Courage is not caring what other people think.
勇气不是在枪林弹雨中冲锋陷阵，而是不在乎别人怎么想。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
Value your time. It is all you have. It’s more important than your money. It’s more important than your friends. It is more important than anything. Your time is all you have. Do not waste your time.
珍惜自己的时间。你唯一真正拥有的就是时间。时间比金钱更重要，比朋友更重要，比什么都重要。你的时间就是你的一切。不要浪费自己的时间。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
Don’t spend your time making other people happy. Other people being happy is their problem. It’s not your problem.
不要花自己的时间去取悦别人。别人快不快乐是他们的问题，不是你的问题。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
People who live far below their means enjoy a freedom that people busy upgrading their lifestyles can’t fathom.
那些生活水平远远低于自己收入水平的人享受着一种自由，这种自由是那些忙于不断提升自己的生活方式的人无法企及的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
A taste of freedom can make you unemployable.
一旦品尝到自由的滋味，你就再也不想被别人雇用了。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself

quotes.quote:
A busy mind accelerates the passage of subjective time.
忙碌的思绪会加速主观时间的流逝。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part II: Happiness: Saving Yourself, Section: Choosing to Free Yourself
